qa.question: How did the backfill script initialize activity history for existing notes?
qa.answer: If activity_history was missing/empty, it set it to a single 'created' activity using created_at (or utcnow).

qa.question: Why didn’t the calendar update after creating a new note, and what was the proposed fix to ensure refresh on tab switch?
qa.answer: PlannerView wasn't refetching because it stayed mounted; adding key={currentTab} forces remount and reload when switching to the Calendar tab.
evidence: D1:32: "<plan_mode_respond> <response> Good catch! I can see the activity_history IS in the backend data - your test notes show both "created" and "updated" activities.  **The actual problem:** The calendar doesn't reload when you switch tabs. React keeps PlannerView mounted in the background, so when you switch from Notes → Calendar, it doesn't refetch the note activities.  **The Fix:**  Add a `key` prop to force PlannerView to remount (and reload data) every time you switch to it:  ```tsx // In App.tsx {currentTab === 2 && (   <PlannerView      key={currentTab}  // <- Add this line     initialSelectedTaskId={selectedTaskId}     onNavigateToNote={handleNavigateToNote}   /> )} ```  This forces React to completely remount PlannerView when you switch to tab 2, which triggers the `useEffect` and fetches fresh note activities.  **Toggle to Act mode** and I'll add this one-line fix! </response> <task_progress> - [x] Phase 1: Backend Activity Tracking - [x] Phase 2: Calendar Integration - [x] Phase 3: Day View Modal - [x] Phase 4: Testing & Polish - [ ] Phase 5: Fix Tab Switch Refresh   - [x] Confirmed backend has activity_history data   - [x] Identified issue: PlannerView doesn't remount on tab switch   - [ ] Add key prop to force remount in App.tsx   - [ ] Test that activities refresh when switching tabs </task_progress> </plan_mode_respond>"
